datasets.notes: Superseded for active counts because 13 stale saved cases fail the current single-step queryworthiness gate, including the low-information IV4 detection table-header prompt.

Generated after tightening single-step queryworthiness to reject placeholder/icon-only table cells, cross-reference-only notes, and bracketed page-reference fragments. Remaining failures are retrieval latency timeouts, not stale-question artifacts.

unit_tests.command: docker compose -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml exec -T api python -m pytest tests/unit -q
unit_tests.notes: Full unit suite passed after product-family structured lookups stopped hard-scoping chunk search to inferred metadata-selected documents. Focused retrieval suite also passed: tests/unit/test_retriever.py -> 78 passed, 1 warning.

evals.notes: Replacement validated single-step bank improved from 19/20 to 20/20. Product-family-only structured table lookups no longer use inferred metadata-selected documents as hard chunk-search scope, so the LJ-X8000 PLC link-unit row is retrievable even when metadata selection chooses a related X8000 brochure/document set.
No-regression check for the cleaned saved single-step bank stayed 27/27 under the standard 8-second timeout.
No-regression check for the refined warning-plus-step multi-step bank stayed 15/15 under the standard 8-second timeout.

Product-family structured lookups now skip the supplemental table lexical scan while keeping focused table vector/special routes. Replacement validated single-step bank improved from 17/20 to 19/20; eval_timeout dropped from 3 to 0. Remaining miss is an LJ-X8000 PLC link-unit wrong-document/candidate selection case.
No-regression check for the cleaned saved single-step bank stayed 27/27 under the standard 8-second timeout.
No-regression check for the refined warning-plus-step multi-step bank stayed 15/15 under the standard 8-second timeout.

Fresh validated replacement single-step questions no longer include the stale placeholder/icon/cross-reference/page-reference artifacts. All misses were standard 8-second retrieval timeouts, making structured/table latency the next target.
No-regression rerun of the cleaned saved single-step bank stayed 27/27 under the standard 8-second timeout after the eval-quality change.

The saved single-step bank now has an opt-in queryworthiness cleaner for stale saved cases. It retired 13 cases current generation would not use as standalone prompts, including the low-information IV4 detection table-header prompt, and the remaining 27 cases passed 27/27 under the standard 8-second timeout.
No-regression check for the refined warning-plus-step multi-step bank stayed 15/15 under the normal 8-second timeout after the eval harness cleaning change.

Structured message/symbol/description/summary/detection lookups now require the requested table field as well as the subject term, so the LJ-X8000 PROFINETunit error-message row outranks unrelated trigger-mode PROFINET rows. Saved single-step improved from 38/40 to 39/40 under the standard 8-second timeout. The remaining failure is the old low-information IV4 detection table-header prompt.
No-regression check for the refined warning-plus-step multi-step bank stayed 15/15 after the structured field/subject ranking change.

Structured product/part lookup queries now skip the supplemental lexical table scan, removing the KV-NC32T timeout; lexical table scans now order bounded candidates by priority before scoring. Saved single-step improved from 37/40 to 38/40 with no eval_timeout failures and 100% candidate recall. Remaining failures are the LJ-X8000 PROFINET message row selection and the old low-information IV4 detection table-header prompt.
No-regression check for the refined warning-plus-step multi-step bank stayed 15/15 after the single-step latency changes.

Safety warning records are now a distinct retrieval family with exact warning-phrase alignment. The IV4 master-number warning/status paired-evidence miss recovered, restoring this saved warning-step bank to 15/15 under the standard 8-second timeout.

Saved single-step bank remained 37/40 (92.5%) under the standard 8-second timeout after the safety-ranking change. Remaining failures are the known KV structured lookup timeout and two ranking/context losses.

Refreshed diagnostic stayed 34/40 (85%) under the standard 8-second timeout. XG-X summary and LJ-S8000 AIM symbol rows improved in spot probes, but the generated mix still had 6 failures, so it remains diagnostic-only.

Saved single-step bank was 37/40 (92.5%) under the standard 8-second timeout, below the earlier 90-second recovery artifact retrieval_eval_20260824_145600 at 39/40. Failures were eval_timeout: 1 and ranking_or_context_loss: 2.

Saved refined warning-step bank was 14/15 (93.33%) under the standard 8-second timeout, below the prior 15/15 gate. The miss had candidate recall but lacked paired warning/status context in final top-k.

Single-step recovery run after restoring the table-only vector route for structured lookups and tightening structured lexical/query-analysis shapes. The 14:29 diagnostic regression recovered from 34/40 to 39/40; remaining miss is the old low-information IV4 detection prompt.
Structured lookup route pruning removed the saved KV-X eval_timeout; saved single-step bank stayed 38/40 (95%) with failures now wrong_document_or_filter_loss: 1 and ranking_or_context_loss: 1.
No-regression check for the refined warning-plus-step multi-step bank stayed 15/15 (100%).

Diagnostic refreshed deterministic single-step bank without standalone table-header prompts completed 34/40 (85%); not promoted to durable question-bank list because it exposed new ranking/document-selection failures.

Eval scoring now treats product-applicable equivalent table evidence as answerable evidence; the IV4-G600CA PDO case passes at rank 1. Saved single-step bank remains 38/40 (95%); remaining failures are one KV-X eval_timeout and the old low-quality IV4 detection table-header prompt.
No-regression check for the refined warning-plus-step multi-step bank stayed at 15/15 (100%) after the eval scoring update.
Safety applies-when route now includes atomic action evidence, improving the refined warning-step bank from 14/15 (93.33%) to 15/15 (100%).
Saved single-step regression bank held at 37/40 (92.5%) after adding atomic action evidence to safety applies-when special routes.

Safety special route cleanup improved refined warning-step bank from 12/15 (80%) to 14/15 (93.33%) and removed all scored eval_timeout failures. Remaining miss has candidate recall but lacks paired remaining-buffers action evidence in final top-k.
Saved single-step regression bank held at 37/40 (92.5%) after safety route cleanup; metadata document rank-1 rate improved slightly to 71.79%.

Safety action-overlap ranking improved the refined warning-step bank from 11/15 (73.33%) to 12/15 (80%); the previously exposed IV4 master-number warning/context miss now passes at rank 1. Remaining failures are three IV4 warning/status 8-second timeouts.

Exact product-model scoring restored the saved single-step bank from 36/40 (90%) to 37/40 (92.5%); the IV4-G600CA PDO Source Sub Index case now passes at rank 1 and metadata document selection recall is 100%.

Order-insensitive special-route dedupe removed duplicate safety warning/procedure searches and improved the refined warning-step bank from 8/15 (53.33%) to 11/15 (73.33%); timeout failures dropped from 7 to 3.
Single-step regression bank held at the prior latest 36/40 (90%) after the safety-route latency fix; remaining failures are the existing timeout/ranking/wrong-document cluster.

Refined warning-step question generation removed generic manual labels and prohibition/status pseudo-steps; generated 15 more realistic validated cases. Remaining failures are all 8-second retrieval timeouts, mainly IV4 warning/status routes.
A smaller safety/procedure rerank pool was tested and reverted because the generated warning-step eval dropped to 7/15 with 8 timeouts.

Safety/procedure route pruning improved the saved warning-plus-step multi-step bank from 10/18 (55.56%) to 11/18 (61.11%) and reduced timeout failures from 8 to 6; one former timeout now completes as a ranking/context loss.

Saved single-step bank checked after route pruning at 36/40 (90%), below the prior 37/40 run; failures are the existing VS/IV4 timeout, ranking/context, and document-selection cases. Treat as a watch item while continuing latency and ranking work.

First warning-plus-step exploratory multi-step bank generated 18 validated questions. Retrieval found both operational-step and warning evidence for 10/18; all failures were 8-second eval timeouts, so latency is the next target before treating these as recall misses.

Saved 40-case single-step bank held at 37/40 (92.5%). The IV4-G600CA PDO wrong-document miss now passes and metadata document recall rose to 100%; remaining failures are one eval timeout plus two ranking/context losses.

Saved contextual procedure-plus-section multi-step bank stayed at 19/20 (95%) after deterministic contextual lexical pre-limit ordering. The prior LJ-X8000 high-speed image-capture candidate miss now passes at rank 1; the remaining failure is an 8-second eval timeout on an XG-X contextual case, so timeout pressure remains the next runtime target.

Saved contextual procedure-plus-section multi-step bank improved from 18/20 (90%) to 19/20 (95%). Preserving inferred menu labels as scoring signals rather than hard filters fixed the XG-X Step 2/3 Trigger Settings case; one LJ-X8000 high-speed image-capture support case remains.

Saved 40-case single-step bank held at 37/40 (92.5%). Numbered-prefix model parsing is covered, but the IV4-G600CA PDO row remains a wrong-document/filter-loss case and needs deeper generic metadata/table ranking work.

First broader contextual multi-step bank for procedure-plus-section evidence passed 17/20 at rank 1. The stricter generator filters out numeric-only procedure labels and same-page unrelated support by requiring local-context linkage. Remaining failures cluster in LJ-X8000 setup-guide image-capture timing questions where metadata document selection/candidate recall misses the expected document.

Saved 20-case multi-step sibling table-row bank improved from 14/20 (70%) to 20/20 (100%), all at rank 1. Fix keeps structured troubleshooting table lookups in the table family even when phrased as how/correction questions, and adds a generic lexical table-row candidate source under original request filters.
Saved 40-case single-step bank improved from 35/40 (87.5%) to 37/40 (92.5%) with candidate and metadata-document recall both at 100%; remaining failures are ranking/context-loss only.

Saved 20-case multi-step sibling table-row bank improved from 10/20 (50%) to 14/20 (70%) after classifying cause/correction questions as structured table lookups and exposing nearest table row-group context to retrieval eval and answering. Scored eval_timeout dropped from 2 to 0.

First exploratory multi-step bank for sibling table rows requiring error/symptom, cause, and corrective-action evidence. Failures mostly indicate context assembly/ranking gaps rather than document-selection misses.

Saved-bank apples-to-apples run improved from 34/40 to 35/40 after table-header demotion; the previous XG-X error-message table-cell case passed at rank 1. Remaining misses all have candidate recall and are ranking/context-selection failures.

Refreshed deterministic generation after table question specificity changes produced a harder 40-case single-step eval dataset. It was not added as a durable question-bank file; use it as coverage evidence for candidate/document-selection gaps.

Structured applies-to field lookup routing improved saved-bank pass rate from 80% to 85%; wrong-document/filter losses dropped to zero, including the IV4 PDO sub-index case. Remaining misses all have candidate recall and are ranking/context-selection failures.

Regenerated deterministic exploratory bank uses product_family labels when product_model lists are too long. AS_151292 VS cases improved to 10/11 passed; remaining failures are mostly reranking/context loss, with candidate recall at 97.5%.

Full saved-bank direct eval completed without eval_timeout failures after one unscored warmup. All 6 AS_151292 VS manual cases still failed, making VS/table/document-selection misses the next retrieval target.
10-case warmup smoke run confirmed startup cost is no longer scored as eval_timeout; remaining misses are retrieval/document-selection failures.

Corrected bounded run after native sparse search and timeout re-raise fix. First query still timed out while paying reranker/model warmup; the two warmed queries passed at rank 1 in 2.510s and 1.092s.

Same-run 10-case evidence after native sparse search improved the saved-bank sample from the prior 7/10 to 8/10, but the first query exceeded the intended timeout because sparse fallback caught the timeout exception before the final re-raise fix.

Bounded direct-mode eval now completes and writes artifacts; manual direct retrieval of the first case exceeded 60 seconds, so the next bottleneck is retrieval/model latency rather than only HTTP overhead.
Useful saved-bank result artifact found at the start of the timeout-control run; only the summary file was present as an untracked artifact.

Stopped after about 90 seconds to preserve cron budget; first completed case returned rank null. The smaller 10-query retry also stalled for about 2 minutes after loading cases and was stopped before first result.
Separate LLM-generated live eval attempt produced no completed cases after about 2 minutes and was stopped for cron budget; this completed run used deterministic fallback generation.
